headlines.title: More than a dozen people feared missing in Grand Canyon flash floods
headlines.description: More than a dozen people are feared missing after powerful flash floods swept through the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service said Sunday. One hiker recounts being airlifted from the campground after the floodwaters forced dozens of people to evacuate. NBC News’ Dana Griffin has the latest.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Authorities in Nepal have warned of further flooding after heavy rainfall, as China sheds more light on the scale of the disaster in its Tibet region.

headlines.title: Rescue Efforts Intensify After Catastrophic Mudslide in Nepal
headlines.description: The search for survivors of the devastating flash flood in Nepal is intensifying in a race against time. The death toll has reached 750 and 2,500 people are officially missing five days after the disaster. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: NBC Crew, Palestinian Woman Attacked by Masked Israeli Settlers
headlines.description: NBC’s Matt Bradley joins Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist to share an update after he, along with members of our news crew and a Palestinian woman, were attacked by settlers in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accused the settlers of breaking the law and damaging Israel’s standing the world. Warning: The incident was disturbing.

headlines.title: Water cuts are coming for Arizona. Is your salad on the chopping block?
headlines.description: Yuma County, Arizona grows 90% of the U.S.’ winter salad greens. But the state relies on the depleted Colorado River, and water cuts are about to hit.

headlines.title: New Mexico man accused of fatally shooting cousin after argument over enchiladas
headlines.description: Police say the men had been drinking and arguing before a fistfight broke out. A witness said the victim was walking away when Ervin Gutierrez pulled a gun and opened fire.
